global_tests.null_hypothesis: Draws are compatible with uniform sampling of six distinct numbers from 1..49.
global_tests.warning: Evidence against a null hypothesis is not evidence of predictive advantage.

levels.descriptive: What happened in the validated historical archive.
levels.inference: Whether observed deviations are unusual under a uniform 6/49 null.
levels.prediction: Only out-of-sample temporal backtests can assess predictive value.

monte_carlo_null.selection_mechanism: six unique numbers sampled uniformly without replacement per draw
